commands.name: acp
commands.description: Bridge local coding agents (claude, codex, grok, agy) to paired mobile browsers.

options.name: --publicUrl
options.description: The relay server URL.

options.name: --log
options.description: Client log verbosity.

options.name: --name
options.description: Desktop profile name; the same profile keeps the same address.

options.name: --identity-file
options.description: Desktop profile file (identity and paired devices).

options.name: --cwd
options.description: Default working directory for new agent sessions.

options.name: --install-hooks
options.description: Install transparent PTY shell hooks so terminal agent sessions can be controlled and approved from mobile.

options.name: --uninstall-hooks
options.description: Remove transparent PTY shell hooks from your shell profile.

options.name: --hooks-status
options.description: Inspect PTY shell hook installation status and active PTY sessions.

options.name: --shell
options.description: Optional shell override for --install-hooks / --uninstall-hooks (zsh, bash, fish, pwsh, powershell).

options.name: --agents
options.description: Optional comma-separated list of agent commands to wrap with --install-hooks (default: claude,codex,grok,agy).

options.name: --pty
options.description: Run an interactive coding agent inside a transparent PTY with a local control socket (used by shell hooks).

arguments.name: PROVIDER
arguments.description: Optional coding agent filter: claude, codex, grok, or agy (default: all).
